reported.title: Debounce settle logic misses valid presses
reported.description: scanStart() only accepts a press once rawLevel has been stable for SETTLE_MS (20 ms) at line 46, and it resets rawChangedAt on every edge at lines 41-45. A press that is interrupted by a bounce edge, or that arrives while a prior spike train keeps rawChangedAt fresh, never reaches the stable window, so openZone() at line 51 is never called; measured evidence shows D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 3.00 s, 1.02 s, and 1.00 s. Because the debounce requires a full 20 ms of uninterrupted stability before acting, presses near the settle boundary or with bounce spaced under 20 ms are dropped entirely rather than accepted. D10 missed 1 of 4 trigger(s): D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 3.00 s.

judge_input.spec:
- Zone valve relay on D10; start button on D6 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D6 opens the valve (D10 HIGH) for 500 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 12 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D10 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `zone n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
